The '''secret underground tunnels''' beneath the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|underworld]], were a well kept secret for thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], their existence was discovered. [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Doorn]] with the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] was tasked with recovering the plans to the underground tunnels.
